claims.explanation: JZL-184 inhibits MAGL, the enzyme that hydrolyzes 2-AG, so sensitive tumors are likely those with high MGLL expression and an active endocannabinoid system (e.g., CNR1, DAGLA) that depend on MAGL-driven lipid signaling and 2-AG-mediated effects. PTEN loss may further sensitize through PI3K/AKT-driven lipid dependency, while PIK3CA and STK11 mutations mark resistant lines in the observed screen. The mutation features are based on enrichment patterns among the provided sensitive versus resistant lines.
